acquired.name: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic)
acquired.provider: W. Wolberg, O. Mangasarian — UCI Machine Learning Repository
acquired.notes: Public research dataset. diagnosis M/B is the label. Column headers reconstructed from wdbc.names (the original file has no header). Outputs must not be presented as medical diagnoses.

acquired.name: Credit Card Fraud Detection
acquired.provider: Universite Libre de Bruxelles (MLG) — original Kaggle dataset
acquired.license: ODbL (Open Database License) per original distribution
acquired.notes: Financial research dataset (PCA-anonymised features, 'Class' label, 0.172% fraud). Downloaded via OpenML because Kaggle authentication was unavailable. Not a live payment integration.

acquired.name: Individual Household Electric Power Consumption
acquired.provider: Georges Hebrail, Alice Berard — UCI Machine Learning Repository
acquired.notes: Minute-level electrical measurements of one household (2006-2010). Timestamps derived from Date+Time; '?' missing values → NaN. Ideal genuine time-series for the IoT replay simulator.

acquired.name: UCI Air Quality
acquired.provider: S. De Vito et al. — UCI Machine Learning Repository
acquired.notes: Air-quality sensor measurements (CO, NMHC, C6H6, NOx, NO2, O3, temperature, humidity) from an Italian city. -200 missing markers converted to NaN. Timestamp column derived from Date+Time.
